label: Theology
title: Jerusalem Temple — A Fresh Look at Pentecost
excerpt: For two millennia, most teachers have placed the birth of the New Testament Church in the Upper Room (Acts 2). Dr. Sunny Ezhumattoor offers a careful, Scripture-first re-examination that addresses the questions readers keep asking but rarely see answered: Where could thousands hear Peter at once? How were 3,000 baptized in a single day?
